200020177.title: Expression data from mouse wild-type and Dnmt1-/-Dnmt3a-/-Dnmt3b-/- embryonic stem(ES) cells and nuclear transfer-trophoblastic stem(ntTS) cells, and wild-type trophoblastic stem(TS) cells, primitive endoderm cells, and extra-embryonic endoderm(XEN) cells
200020177.summary: To investigate the role of DNA methylation in early embryogenesis, we created Dnmt1-/-Dnmt3a-/-Dnmt3b-/- triple knockout (TKO) embryos by the nuclear transfer (NT) technique using TKO ES cells as the nucleus donor, and found that the TKO NT embryos could develop into blastocysts. From the TKO NT blastocysts, we successfully established trophoblastic stem cells (ntTS cells), and these TKO ntTS cells could self-renew and contribute to the placenta in vivo. Expression profile analysis using microarray revealed that, although many genes were aberrantly expressed, the fundamental gene expression patterns of stem cells were retained in these TKO ntTS cells.
